about: Labelled (old, new) note pairs for consolidation. Labels: superseded (new replaces old's value/state), contradiction (same time, incompatible), duplicate (same facts), subsumed (one note states every fact of the other, plus more), merge (same subject, compatible, complementary details), distinct (related or unrelated facts that must stay separate). `src: spacemaker` pairs come from the live SpaceMaker store (2026-10-03). pattern: two separate episodes of one repeated behaviour (should become a promote proposal).

pairs.label: superseded
pairs.old: SpaceMaker .mcp.json launches the webnav MCP from the local checkout ${HOME}/Projects/Code/Python/MCPs/webnav-ts-mcp/bin/launch.mjs until the package is published on npm.
pairs.new: On 2026-09-30 SpaceMaker switched its webnav MCP to the published npm package webnav-ts-mcp, launched with `npx --yes webnav-ts-mcp@^0.1.1` in .mcp.json and .cursor/mcp.json; the first start downloads about 180 MB into npm's cache.

pairs.label: superseded
pairs.old: SpaceMaker as-is moves treat a destination file with the same size as a duplicate and drop the source file.
pairs.new: On 2026-10-02 SpaceMaker changed as-is move duplicate detection: _move_to_folder drops the source only if files_have_same_content (size plus 1 MiB chunk comparison is identical), otherwise it writes `name (2).ext`; this corrected the earlier rule that same size means duplicate, which could drop a different file.

pairs.new: On 2026-09-27 SpaceMaker renamed the library folder converted/ to processed/; the legacy on-disk name converted/ is migrated to processed/ when the library is ensured.

pairs.label: superseded
pairs.old: SpaceMaker's gallery index folder is named converted/ and holds encoded and moved-as-is files.
pairs.new: SpaceMaker library root folders are originals/ (extract target), processed/ (gallery index), error/ (encode failed after one retry) and invalid/ (unsupported or broken media).

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.old: SpaceMaker Phase 0 (Design) deliverable is wireframes/<screen>.html, a self-contained HTML/CSS file, and the agent must stop and ask for UX/design approval afterwards.
pairs.new: In SpaceMaker one gate is passed per explicit approval: do not batch Phase 0 to Phase 4 in one run, and after the wireframe end the turn and wait.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.old: SpaceMaker library root folders are originals/ (extract target), processed/ (gallery index), error/ (encode failed after one retry) and invalid/ (unsupported or broken media).
pairs.new: SpaceMaker retries a failed encode once, deleting the partial output first; if it fails again the file goes to error/, and unsupported or broken files go to invalid/.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.old: On 2026-09-30 SpaceMaker's Components screen omits the AFC tools (idevice_*, ifuse) on macOS and Windows and shows an OK chip when all required tools resolve, including those found on PATH.
pairs.new: On 2026-09-30 SpaceMaker prepends Homebrew and host package-manager bin directories to PATH so tools installed there resolve.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.old: On 2026-09-29 SpaceMaker added the independent code-grader subagent for SDD Phase 5 with a mechanical pre-check script, so grading does not depend on the implementing agent's own judgment.
pairs.new: SpaceMaker Phase 5 (Grade) runs the read-only code-grader subagent against the spec; it is automatic with no approval needed, FAILs are fixed in at most 2 rounds, and the scorecard is shown to the user.

pairs.label: merge
pairs.old: AGENTS.md says to act as if SpaceMaker will grow large: keep layer boundaries, ports, specs, wireframes and tests even for trivial changes, because the project is small today but should survive growth.
pairs.new: User preference of Daniel (SpaceMaker owner), stated in AGENTS.md: always keep layer boundaries and tests even when a change feels trivial, and prefer conventions and clear abstractions over one-off fixes.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.old: SpaceMaker never uses CPU video encoders: it encodes video with GPU hardware only (priority av1_nvenc, av1_qsv, av1_vaapi, h264_nvenc, h264_qsv, h264_vaapi) and moves the source unchanged when no hardware encoder exists.
pairs.new: SpaceMaker never library-encodes video to HEVC; AV1 outputs use Opus 256k audio and H.264 outputs use AAC audio.

pairs.label: distinct
pairs.old: On 2026-09-30 SpaceMaker moved the codenav-mcp, webnav-mcp and mcp-nav-shared packages out of the repo into their own repositories and now depends on the PyPI releases.
pairs.new: On 2026-09-30 SpaceMaker first ran webnav from the local checkout experiments/webnav-mcp-ts, then moved it to its own repo webnav-ts-mcp and dropped experiments/ from SpaceMaker; the Python webnav-mcp is no longer used by this repo.
